limitations: Static setup inspected; all changes are verbal hypotheticals, no movement/reach proof or render review.

exactOffendingText: Whether an inside pass is now usable
Whether staying at the boards is always required
Whether F2’s earlier position still guarantees an outlet
rows.reason: F2 lane opens directly announces checking inside pass; other choices invoke always or guarantees rather than actual competing puck decisions.

optionAssessments.text: Whether an inside pass is now usable
optionAssessments.reason: Correct conditional check of actual inside outlet.

optionAssessments.text: Whether staying at the boards is always required
optionAssessments.reason: Always required at boards is not a plausible universal principle.

optionAssessments.text: Whether F2’s earlier position still guarantees an outlet
optionAssessments.reason: Earlier position cannot guarantee availability now.

rows.repairDirection: Compare real inside/wall options using shown geometry, or remove universals and give matched conditional action alternatives.

exactOffendingText: Keep the route because it was open earlier
Reconsider pace, direction or F2’s outlet
Assume F2 will remain available without checking
rows.reason: Reconsider pace, direction or outlet includes nearly every sensible action. Other options demand outdated information or unchecked availability, so no U11 scene-based comparison is needed.

optionAssessments.text: Keep the route because it was open earlier
optionAssessments.reason: Earlier openness alone does not justify continuing, though route may reopen.

optionAssessments.text: Reconsider pace, direction or F2’s outlet
optionAssessments.reason: Broad reconsideration is reasonable but does not discriminate a read.

optionAssessments.text: Assume F2 will remain available without checking
optionAssessments.reason: Unchecked assumption is obvious wrong wording.

rows.repairDirection: Ask which shown cue distinguishes two specific carries/outlets; preserve uncertainty in future timing.

rows.reason: Changed teammate traffic is expressly hypothetical. Rechecking and slowing or rerouting is a legitimate collision-avoidance/control principle; no fixed turn direction or successful execution promised.

optionAssessments.text: Keep the planned turn without another look
optionAssessments.reason: Without another look neglects teammate entering route.

optionAssessments.text: Reassess space and slow or choose another route
optionAssessments.reason: Reassess and slow or reroute preserves alternatives rather than guaranteed maneuver.

optionAssessments.text: Aim at F2’s original empty spot without checking D1
optionAssessments.reason: Newly vacated F2 spot might be useful only after checking D1; unchecked aiming is poor.

rows.repairDirection: None required for introductory traffic awareness; optional harder lane comparison later.

exactOffendingText: A controlled shot through the newly available lane
Only a pass to the same half-wall spot
Shooting without checking the changed pressure
rows.reason: The new clear lane makes shot reconsideration plausible, but c duplicates shooting with without checking and b uses only to exclude alternatives. Answer is supplied by stem plus sensible wording.

optionAssessments.text: A controlled shot through the newly available lane
optionAssessments.reason: Controlled shot reconsideration is conditional, not promised goal.

optionAssessments.text: Only a pass to the same half-wall spot
optionAssessments.reason: Half-wall pass can remain useful; only makes it falsely mandatory.

optionAssessments.text: Shooting without checking the changed pressure
optionAssessments.reason: Same shooting action as key stripped of checking; weak distractor.

rows.repairDirection: Use matched actual shot/pass comparisons with scene cue; retain control/goalie uncertainty.

rows.reason: Explicit acceleration/gets-beside hypothetical supports reconsidering recovery toward defended right goal. Fixed distance and ignoring carrier are meaningful beginner defensive misconceptions; no exact turn mandated.

optionAssessments.text: How to recover while protecting the route to goal
optionAssessments.reason: Recovery protecting goal is appropriately bounded.

optionAssessments.text: Whether the original distance must remain fixed
optionAssessments.reason: Universal fixed gap ignores changed speed.

optionAssessments.text: Whether YOU should follow F2 regardless of the carrier
optionAssessments.reason: F2 is opposing receiver, but following regardless of carrier ignores primary changed threat.
